## [2026-07-06] CSA — Wholesale pack readability + edit ANY order (FULLSTACK_BUILDER)

Two fixes from Todd watching a confused pack crew. NOT DEPLOYED, migration NOT applied.

**FIX 1 — `/admin/wholesale/pack` readability.** `src/pages/admin/wholesale/pack/index.astro` rewritten for the pack crew.

## [2026-07-06] CSA — Pick & Pack: new PACK HOUSE distribution matrix (crop × destination) (FULLSTACK_BUILDER)

Todd's need: "All of a certain crop comes off the field at the same time. The pack crew's job is to get the right amount of the right product to the correct destination." The existing Pick & Pack views answer "how much of each crop do we pick?"; this new `?view=packhouse` view answers "…and where does every unit of it go?" — a per-crop × per-destination MATRIX so a crew member holding a crate of one crop reads ACROSS the row and splits it to its final homes. NOT DEPLOYED.

**BUILD.**
- **`src/lib/pick-pack.ts` — additive helper `buildDestinationMatrix(merged, dests)` (existing exports/merge signature UNTOUCHED).** Takes the SAME `merged` rows the overall harvest view renders + a list of destination-tagged demand (`DestDemandInput`: crop/qty/unit/kind/destKey/destLabel) and returns `{ columns, rows }`. Rows are 1:1 with `merged` in merged order (tender-first) and REUSE each merged row's `totalQty` verbatim — no separate math. Cells accumulate by `normCrop` (same key the merge dedupes on) so two demand rows sharing a destKey (a restaurant's two orders; a market's two offerings of a crop) SUM into one cell. Columns are only emitted for destinations with demand, ordered CSA → markets → wholesale accounts → Flex, first-seen within each kind (caller controls intra-kind order). Per-row `dominantUnit` + `mixedUnits` flag drive the "show the unit once, per-cell only when it differs" display. Added 6 bilingual strings (`packhouseTab/Title/Subtitle/Hint`, `notesCol`, `cropCol`) to `PICK_PACK_STRINGS` EN + ES.
- **`src/pages/admin/pick-pack/[...slug].astro` — the `?view=packhouse` view.** Added to the view type union + the screen view-switcher nav (📦 Pack House / Casa de empaque). Same `?day=mon/thu` scoping + `?week` + `?lang=es` as the other views; language toggle button extended to this crew-facing sheet. Matrix construction runs ONLY for this view (it needs one extra read — `wholesale_accounts.restaurant_name`): CSA from `csaRows` (destKey 'csa'), one column per in-scope market from `marketGroupsSorted`/`marketInScope` (mirrors `marketAllMap`), one column per wholesale ACCOUNT resolved from `wholesale_accounts` (multiple orders same restaurant summed; account-less orders → shared "(no account)" column so nothing drops from the total), Flex from `flexRows`. Every cell is fed from the SAME scoped source + SAME scope filter the merge uses, so a row's cells sum to its total by construction. Renders as a semantic `<table>` with a blank dashed **Wash / notes** pen box per row (Todd: "logged to be washed or whatever attention it needs"), a tender left-edge accent + badge, faint per-kind column tints, `—` for empty cells, `*` on mixed-unit totals. NO live check-off (the interactive harvest/pack check-off stays on the other views — the config div + summary are gated off for packhouse, `ppSection` maps it to 'harvest' only to satisfy the type; ppKeys stays empty).
- **Print CSS — landscape via a NAMED page.** `@page pack-landscape { size: Letter landscape }` applied only through `.packhouse-doc { page: pack-landscape }`, so every OTHER view keeps the untouched default Letter-portrait `@page`. Matrix prints compact, repeats the header row per page, keeps each row whole, tall pen box; on SCREEN the crop column is sticky + the grid scrolls horizontally. The `account_id` added to the wholesale `select` is additive — the existing `wholesaleMap` loop ignores it, so the overall/wholesale views are byte-identical.

**Verification.** `npm run build` → Complete (0 errors). `npx astro check` → **11 errors / 0 warnings / 61 hints** — IDENTICAL to the pre-existing baseline, zero new. `npm run test:unit` → green (25 framework tests + all inline pick-pack assertions). Added `buildDestinationMatrix` unit tests proving the core invariant end-to-end: for a fixture with CSA + 2 markets + 2 restaurants (one with 2 orders) + Flex, every matrix row total == the merged row total == Σ its destination cells; column ordering, per-restaurant summing, dominant/mixed-unit, and empty→no-column all asserted. Other views' rendering + print unchanged (matrix section, named page, and account read are all gated to `view === 'packhouse'`).

## [2026-07-06] CSA — Monday "Today" deck: direct Market Wagon pick-ticket link, zero inbox-digging (FULLSTACK_BUILDER)

Market Wagon emails todd@tinyseedfarmpgh.com every Monday ~5:25 AM ET from `no-reply@marketwagon.com` (subject "Pick Ticket - MM-DD-YYYY"); the HTML body carries a LOGIN-GATED link `https://admin.marketwagon.com/pages/picktickets/?pID=<id>&sID=12590`. It can't be auto-fetched (needs Todd's logged-in browser). Goal: the Monday deck hands him the exact URL so there's no inbox-digging — he clicks, prints to PDF, uploads at `/admin/wholesale/import` (existing manual path, unchanged). NOT DEPLOYED.

**BUILD.**
- **`src/lib/harvie-ingest.ts` — minimal additive refactor (cron behavior byte-identical).** Exported the existing Gmail helpers `getGmailAccessToken`, `gmailSearch`, `gmailGetMessage` and the `GmailPart`/`GmailMessage` types so the new MW helper reuses ONE Gmail integration. `gmailSearch` gained two DEFAULTED params (`query = GMAIL_QUERY`, `maxResults = 25`); the cron's arg-less call site `gmailSearch(accessToken)` resolves to the identical URL. Added one optional `internalDate?: string` field to `GmailMessage`. The cron/admin path (`runHarvieIngest`) is otherwise untouched — verified it still calls `getGmailAccessToken()` → `gmailSearch(accessToken)` → `gmailGetMessage()` with the same query, PDF walk, and commit.
- **NEW `src/lib/mw-ticket.ts` — `findLatestMwPickTicketLink()`.** Searches Gmail `from:no-reply@marketwagon.com subject:"Pick Ticket" newer_than:5d` (newest first), walks each message's MIME tree collecting decoded text/html + text/plain body, and returns `{ url, emailDate }` for the newest message that yields a link, else `null`. FAIL-SOFT everywhere: missing config, token/search/read failure, or no matching mail → `null` (never throws, never breaks the page). `extractMwPickTicketLink()` (exported for traceability) matches `https://admin.marketwagon.com/pages/picktickets/?…` up to the next whitespace/angle-bracket, then (1) decodes `&amp;` → `&` (email HTML encodes the query separators) and (2) strips a trailing quote/apostrophe artifact — the observed stray trailing `'` from single-quoted `href='…'`.
- **`src/components/TodayFlow.astro` — Monday step 3 (Market Wagon).** Server-side calls the helper, kicked off in parallel with the Supabase queries and gated INSIDE the `mode === 'mon'` block, so Gmail is touched ONLY on the Monday deck render (never Wed–Sun) — the "avoid needless API calls" guard. If a link is found: a highlighted panel — "This week's pick ticket arrived <ET weekday+time>", a one-line "Open → Print → Save as PDF → Upload", a prominent **Open pick ticket ↗** button (new tab, `rel="noopener"`), and the existing **Upload fill ticket →** link. If null: the current upload link + a note that MW usually emails ~5:25 AM Monday and the link appears once it lands. The step's ✓/⏳ status pill stays driven solely by whether the MW `wholesale_orders` row is imported — unchanged. ts-* tokens throughout; ≥44px touch targets (shared `primaryBtn`/`ghostBtn`).

**Verification.** `npm run build` → Complete (0 errors). `npx astro check` → **11 errors / 0 warnings / 61 hints** across 329 files (+1 for the new lib) — IDENTICAL to the pre-existing 11-error baseline; ZERO errors reference any new/edited file (the only diagnostic touching TodayFlow is a pre-existing ts80006 hint in the unchanged harvie inline `<script>`). Regex traced with a 4-case Node harness (double-quoted href + `&amp;`; single-quoted href reproducing + cleaning the trailing `'`; plain-text bare URL; no-link → null) → 4/4 pass, all yielding `…?pID=48213&sID=12590`. Harvie cron unchanged: the only external importer of the touched exports besides `mw-ticket.ts` is `runHarvieIngest`, and its Gmail call sites are byte-identical.

## [2026-07-06] CSA — Market List workflow rebuilt: copy-last-week, bulk check-off, on-the-fly editing (FULLSTACK_BUILDER)

Todd's brief: "adding items one at a time is frustrating — let me check off everything we have and it lands on the plan; repeat last week and just tweak the numbers; make changes on the fly." Lawrenceville market is Tue Jul 7, so Todd uses this today. Rebuilt `/admin/market` (same URL — an upgrade, not a new page) into a per-(week, market) editor. NOT DEPLOYED.

NEW endpoints under `src/pages/api/admin/market/`: `bulk-add.ts` (form→303, check-off + quick-add), `copy-week.ts` (form→303, repeat last week), `update-row.ts` (JSON, optimistic inline qty/unit/price/at-market), `delete-row.ts` (JSON, one-tap remove). All read across ALL markets; my per-market filter only affects the editor's own display. Print actions (signs + price list) preserved in the header. `save.ts` left in place (now unreferenced dead code — safe; candidate for later cleanup).

## [2026-07-05] CSA — Pick & Pack overall harvest totals now include FLEX à-la-carte demand (FULLSTACK_BUILDER)

Todd's directive: the Monday harvest numbers must include flex-committed items so the crew actually harvests them ("so we have them"). Flex items already showed per-member on labels/pack-load/manifests but were ABSENT from the pick-pack per-crop demand merge, so the crew under-harvested by the flex amount. Added flex as a FOURTH demand channel in the OVERALL harvest merge only. NOT DEPLOYED. Files: `src/lib/pick-pack.ts`, `src/pages/admin/pick-pack/[...slug].astro`, `src/lib/pick-pack.test.ts` (new). Verification: `npm run build` → Complete (0 errors); `npx astro check` → **11 errors / 0 warnings** — IDENTICAL to the pre-existing baseline, ZERO new errors in any touched file (the only pick-pack diagnostics are two pre-existing zod ts(6385) *warnings* in the untouched mark.ts/state.ts APIs); `npm run test:unit` fully green (14 lib test files, incl. the new pick-pack.test.ts — 0 failed).

**SCHEMA REALITY (corrects the task's assumption).** There is NO `flex_order_items` table. `flex_orders` is FLAT — one row per member per item (`member_id, flex_item_id, qty, week_starting, cycle_code, status`); item name/unit/category come from joining `flex_inventory` (→ `product_library`). Statuses are `pending | locked | fulfilled | cancelled | refunded` (NOT submitted/confirmed/draft/skipped).

**COUNTED STATUSES = `pending`, `locked`, `fulfilled`** (exclude `cancelled` + `refunded`). This is the canonical "real order for the week" filter every other flex-consuming page already uses (labels, pack-load, host-sheets, route-sheet, stop-manifest, pack-check, harvest). There is no "skipped" status — a member skip CANCELS a pending order (api/account/flex-order/skip.ts), so a skipped week's row is already `cancelled` and drops out.

**lib/pick-pack.ts.** `Channel` gains `'flex'`; `MergedCropRow` gains a `flex: ChannelQty | null` cell; `mergeCropDemand` takes a 4th `flex: CropDemandInput[] = []` param (default `[]` keeps the page's 3-arg single-crop tender probe + any pre-flex caller working) and bumps flex through the SAME `normCrop` matching (flex kale → the kale line; an unmatched flex item becomes its own line). `channelCount` + `multiChannel` now count flex. Added `flexCol` string ('Flex' EN + ES — brand term).

**Page.** New section 4B reads `flex_orders` via the service-role `db` (like market_offerings + wholesale_orders — a CREW user must see the demand; only per-crop aggregates are rendered, never member names). Day scope mirrors CSA EXACTLY via the existing `harvestTabForMember` (Sat/Sun pickup → thu; else → mon), keyed off a `member_id → tab` map from `cycle.members`; on 'all' every counted order is included, on mon/thu only orders whose member maps to that tab, and an order whose member isn't an active cycle member (no resolvable day) counts on 'all' only — same rule as the make-up notices. Base "CSA Share" lines are skipped (box subscription, not a crop). Flex is folded into the OVERALL merge + its per-channel breakdown (the row now shows a "Flex N unit" cell alongside CSA/Market/Wholesale) + the cross-channel totalQty, unit-consensus, and pack-weight-lb sums (packLb is name-keyed off product_library, so flex lbs work identically to other channels). Per the directive: NO new `?view=flex` section (the progress table's section CHECK excludes 'flex'; per-member flex packing already lives on labels/pack-load); CSA/wholesale/market views are untouched.

**LINE KEYS UNCHANGED (verified).** `pickPackLineKey` is derived solely from crop NAME (+ unit for pack views) via `normCrop` — never an array index. Adding flex only changes QUANTITIES on existing crop rows (their `c:<slug>` / `g:<slug>` keys are byte-identical) and appends brand-new rows for flex-only crops (a new crop = a new key, as designed). The `ppKeys` list derives from the same `merged` rows, so summary counts stay consistent. Confirmed by pick-pack.test.ts asserting `pickPackLineKey('row', kale.crop) === 'c:kale'` after a flex bump.

The ONLY behavioral fork is the `onExisting` option: `'replace'` (admin — delete prior items + update order in place, byte-identical to the original) vs `'skip'` (cron — leave an existing (account, delivery_date, PO#) order UNTOUCHED and report `skipped:true`). Error codes (`map_upsert_failed`/`account_create_failed`/`item_delete_failed`/`order_update_failed`/`order_create_failed`/`item_insert_failed`) preserved exactly. **`import/commit.ts` refactored to call it with `onExisting:'replace'`** — same zod validation, same `{ok,order_id,redirect}` success shape, same `{ok:false,error,detail}`+500 error shape. **BUILD A — `/api/cron/harvie-ingest.ts` (new, GET+POST, Bearer CRON_SECRET).** Gmail OAuth refresh-token flow (POST oauth2.googleapis.com/token → access token), searches `from:procurementexpress.com subject:"Purchase Order" has:attachment newer_than:3d`, walks each message's MIME tree for the application/pdf part, downloads via users.messages.attachments.get (base64url → Uint8Array). Extracts text with the SAME `parseWholesalePdf` (unpdf) the manual importer uses → `parseVendorOrder` (vendor 'harvie'; external_ref = PO#, verified derived by the parser at wholesale-import.ts:125). Resolves product mappings from vendor_product_map (mirrors import/parse.ts's `normalizeVendorKey` cross-match; unmapped lines → product_id NULL, pack renders by name). Commits with `onExisting:'skip'`. IDEMPOTENT + SAFE: a second run of the same PO is a no-op — the shared lib finds the existing (account, delivery_date, external_ref) row and returns `{skipped:true}` WITHOUT touching the order or items (never overwrites Todd's hand-edits). Per-message try/catch (one bad PDF never aborts the run); a top-level catch makes a Gmail outage fail-soft (log + FAILED email + notification_log, returns 200 — never 500s). Resend (fail-soft): imported → summary listing lines + flagging unmapped + link to /admin/wholesale/orders; error → "Harvie auto-import FAILED — action needed" naming the reason + the /admin/wholesale/import manual fallback; nothing new → log only (no email noise). notification_log row every run.

**BUILD B — `/api/cron/chef-order-reminder.ts` (new, Bearer CRON_SECRET).** GATED on portal_settings `chef_reminder_enabled` (returns `{ok:true,skipped:'disabled'}` until 'true'). Delivery = `currentDeliveryWednesday()`. Recipients per account resolved by `resolveOrderRecipients(contacts, account.email)` (receives_orders contacts else legacy email); EXCLUDES accounts that already have a non-cancelled wholesale_orders row for that Wednesday, TEST_EXCLUDES addresses, and the vendor accounts (Harvie/Market Wagon — also naturally excluded by having no order recipient). One email per account. **EXACT approved copy** (subject "Ordering for Wednesday closes Tuesday 7 AM"; verbatim body with the /order/<token> link). Resend fail-soft + per-account notification_log.

**BUILD C — `/api/cron/flex-order-reminder.ts` (new, Bearer CRON_SECRET).** GATED on portal_settings `flex_reminder_enabled`. Active flex members joined to customer + pickup day; per member the current OPEN order week is `currentOrderWeek(now, pickupDay)` (pickup-day-aware, lib/flex-order); skips members whose window isn't currently open (`isWindowOpen`), who already placed a non-cancelled flex_orders row for that week, who opted out (member_preferences.newsletter_opt_in=false), who are TEST_EXCLUDES, or whose LIVE Farm Flex balance (`getFlexBalance` → Shopify store credit) is ≤ 0. Copy branches on `isWeekendMarket(pickupDay)`. Per-member notification_log. **⚠ STOP (see report):** the approved copy says "Tuesday 8 AM" but the LIVE cutoff in lib/flex-order (unified 2026-06-26, confirmed by box.test.ts) is **Monday 7 AM (Wednesday run) / Thursday 7 AM (weekend run)** — so a Monday-morning fire will skip most Wednesday-run members (window already closed). The send is gated by the REAL window so it's never wrong to send, but the copy text + the Monday schedule need reconciling before `flex_reminder_enabled` is armed.

**MIGRATION `supabase/migrations/0074_monday_crons.sql` (new, ROOT migrations dir).** Copies the 0033 pg_cron + pg_net + Vault-`cron_secret` pattern. Schedules (UTC): `csa-harvie-ingest` `45 15,16,17 * * 1` (11:45/12:45/1:45 ET, safe to multi-fire via skip-if-exists); `csa-chef-order-reminder` `5 13 * * 1` (09:05 ET); `csa-flex-order-reminder` `10 13 * * 1` (09:10 ET). Idempotent portal_settings seeds `('chef_reminder_enabled','false')`, `('flex_reminder_enabled','false')` (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). Missing-Vault-secret → RAISE NOTICE (jobs left unscheduled, DDL persists). Trailing verify SELECT lists the three jobs.

## [2026-07-05] CSA — CADENCE data-model fix: members.cadence becomes the weekly-vs-biweekly source of truth (FULLSTACK_BUILDER)

Root-caused + fixed the box-allocation data-model flaw where `members.biweekly_week ('A'|'B'|NULL)` was the ONLY cadence signal and the app treated a NULL as "on-week EVERY week" (cycle.ts isMemberOnThisWeek). That single column cannot distinguish a WEEKLY member from a biweekly member not-yet-assigned A/B. Prod consequences (PM-verified vs code + prod + Shopify): (a) a biweekly-unassigned purchaser silently got WEEKLY boxes; (b) weekly members with a stray parity got HALF their boxes; (c) the admin "Unassigned Week A/B" counter was uncomputable; (d) the self-service picker stamped ONE parity across ALL of a mixed household's rows, halving their WEEKLY share (2 Shopify-proven cases). NOT DEPLOYED; **migration 0073 NOT applied** (left local for PM). Behavior-preserving except the 2 evidenced corrections + the self-service scoping fix (which RESTORES paid service).

**MIGRATION `supabase/migrations/0073_member_cadence.sql` (new).** Adds `members.cadence text CHECK (cadence IN ('weekly','biweekly'))` — nullable → backfill → `SET DEFAULT 'weekly'` + `SET NOT NULL`. BEHAVIOR-PRESERVING BACKFILL mirrors today's effective semantics exactly: `cadence='biweekly' WHERE biweekly_week IN ('A','B')`; `cadence='weekly' WHERE biweekly_week IS NULL`. EVIDENCED CORRECTIONS (the only two rows whose behavior changes; identified STRUCTURALLY, never by name; each restores PAID weekly service): (i) active flower `total_weeks>=16 AND biweekly_week='B'` whose customer ALSO has an active summer_veg `total_weeks<=10` → the FLOWER row → `cadence='weekly', biweekly_week=NULL`; (ii) active summer_veg `total_weeks>=16 AND biweekly_week='A'` whose customer ALSO has an active flower `total_weeks<=10` → the SUMMER_VEG row → `cadence='weekly', biweekly_week=NULL`. Each correction runs inside a DO block that COUNTS its structural match and fires ONLY when it isolates EXACTLY ONE row — a 0- or multi-row match is SKIPPED (backfill value stands) with a `RAISE NOTICE` for PM to adjudicate manually (never guesses which row). `COMMENT ON COLUMN` documents the semantics; a trailing verify SELECT reports counts per (cadence, biweekly_week) + the corrected-row signature.

**CORE LOGIC.** `cycle.ts isMemberOnThisWeek` is now cadence-aware: `cadence='weekly'` → always on (ignores any stray A/B); `cadence='biweekly'` + NULL → on-week (legacy-safe, until assigned); `cadence='biweekly'` + A/B → parity (unchanged). `cadence` is OPTIONAL there for back-compat (absent → derive from biweekly_week exactly as before, so every existing caller/test is unaffected). Threaded `cadence` through CycleMember, MemberJoinRow, the resolver SELECT + buildCycleMember. `schedule.ts resolveMemberSchedule` takes optional `cadence` (falls back to the old `biweeklyWeek ? biweekly : weekly` derivation) and returns a new `needsAssignment` flag (true when biweekly + NULL); the unassigned-biweekly case projects the weekly superset (legacy-safe). `vacation.ts` uses the cadence column as authoritative (heuristic `memberIsBiweekly` kept only as fallback).

**BACKEND.** Shopify sync (`api/sync/shopify-orders.ts`) now sets `cadence = categorize().freq` on the member upsert (was discarded) → new biweekly purchasers land `(cadence='biweekly', biweekly_week=NULL)`, visible in the counter + auto-assign, on-week until assigned. `api/account/biweekly-schedule.ts` (bug d) now updates ONLY `cadence='biweekly'` rows (never weekly) — mixed households keep weekly shares weekly; never changes cadence itself. `api/admin/members/[id]/biweekly-week.ts` is now a cadence-aware control writing BOTH columns from a single `schedule` field (weekly / biweekly_a / biweekly_b / biweekly_unassigned; legacy A/B/unassigned values still accepted). `api/admin/biweekly/auto-assign.ts` loadState "needs assignment" = `cadence='biweekly' AND biweekly_week IS NULL` (was: any NULL) — never assigns a parity to a weekly member.

**FRONTEND.** admin/index "Unassigned Week A/B" counter (Phase-0 blocked bug 4) = `cadence='biweekly' && biweekly_week===null`. account/index + dashboard drive weekly-vs-biweekly framing off the cadence column (not the total_weeks heuristic). ScheduleCard shows a gentle "your delivery week will be confirmed soon / Pick your week" note (no false Week A/B claim, no misleading every-week chip list) when `needsAssignment`. account/biweekly-schedule picker only offers A/B/no-preference to members WITH a biweekly-cadence share; a weekly-only household sees a "You get a box every week" info state instead of the picker. admin/members/[id] schedule control is now Weekly / Bi-weekly A / Bi-weekly B / Bi-weekly Unassigned. history + both vacation pages pass cadence through.

**TESTS (before → after, all pass).** cycle.test.ts 47→53 (+6: 3 pure isMemberOnThisWeek cadence cases + 3 resolver-level cadence cases — weekly+strayparity on every week, biweekly+A/B parity preserved, biweekly+NULL on). schedule.test.ts 33→37 (+4: cadence override, needsAssignment, assigned parity, back-compat derivation). vacation.test.ts 23→25 (+2: cadence=weekly overrides stray parity, cadence=biweekly parity). Full `npm run test:unit` green. `npm run build` → Complete (0 errors). `npx astro check` → **11 errors / 0 warnings / 52 hints** — IDENTICAL to baseline (verified by stashing cycle.ts: the lone cycle.ts:697 error is the pre-existing vacation_holds disposition/move_to_week fallback, untouched here); ZERO new errors/warnings/hints in any modified file.

**TOUCHPOINT DISPOSITION (all 23 grep hits + shopify).** CHANGED: cycle.ts, schedule.ts, vacation.ts (+3 tests); database.types.ts; api/sync/shopify-orders.ts; api/account/biweekly-schedule.ts; api/admin/members/[id]/biweekly-week.ts; api/admin/biweekly/auto-assign.ts; admin/index.astro; ScheduleCard.astro; dashboard.astro; account/index.astro; account/history.astro; account/biweekly-schedule.astro; account/vacation.astro; account/vacation/new.astro; admin/members/[id].astro. VERIFIED-NO-CHANGE-NEEDED: **lib/biweekly-assign.ts** (pure algorithm operating only on the caller-supplied unassigned set — the caller now gates on cadence, so no change), **lib/share-buckets.ts** (a DISPLAY grouping BY the raw biweekly_week column — Week A / B / Unassigned filters remain valid; the authoritative "needs assignment" counter is the cadence-aware one on admin/index), **admin/members/index.astro** + **api/admin/reports/[name].csv.ts** (both use `filtersFor()` as a week-column passthrough for the share-bucket filter; kept in lock-step, consistent with the members table, no cadence column exported). STOP items: none — every file's biweekly usage was unambiguous.

Files: `supabase/migrations/0073_member_cadence.sql` (new); `src/lib/{cycle,schedule,vacation}.ts` + `.test.ts`; `src/lib/database.types.ts`; `src/pages/api/sync/shopify-orders.ts`; `src/pages/api/account/biweekly-schedule.ts`; `src/pages/api/admin/members/[id]/biweekly-week.ts`; `src/pages/api/admin/biweekly/auto-assign.ts`; `src/pages/admin/index.astro`; `src/components/ScheduleCard.astro`; `src/pages/dashboard.astro`; `src/pages/account/{index,history,biweekly-schedule,vacation}.astro`; `src/pages/account/vacation/new.astro`; `src/pages/admin/members/[id].astro`.

## [2026-07-05] CSA — Phase 2 Wave 3 retention layer (member recipe browse page + member pickup history) (FULLSTACK_BUILDER)

Final wave: surfaced the EXISTING admin recipe library to members and added a season-so-far pickup history, per `CSA_GAP_RESEARCH_2026-07.md` gaps 7/8 + `CSA_MASTER_PROPOSAL_2026-07.md` 2.7/2.8. Two new member pages, one additive RLS policy, two account-hub cross-links. NOT DEPLOYED; migration 0072 NOT applied — left local for PM. Verification: `npm run build` → Complete (0 errors); `npx astro check` → **11 errors / 0 warnings / 52 hints** (313 files = prior 311 + the 2 new pages), ZERO errors/warnings/hints in any new/modified file (matches the prior 11/0/52 baseline exactly) — all 11 are the same pre-existing baseline (cycle.ts, wholesale/*, campaigns/*, market/sign-edit, pick-pack/*, route/save-optimized, box/swap*, order/[token]).

**BUILD A — `/account/recipes` (`src/pages/account/recipes.astro`, new).** Auth'd member page, two sections. "For your box — <week range>": active recipes matched to the MEMBER's current resolved box. Crop-matching REUSES the weekly-email matcher `matchRecipesToBox` (lib/weekly-email.ts) — I pass `limit = allRecipes.length` so members see EVERY match (the email caps at 3), preserving the farm-then-link interleave; box product names come from the SAME resolution `/box` uses (`resolveBoxContentsBuckets` → box_contents by cycle Monday `mondayOfWeek(upcomingWednesdayET())`). "All recipes": every active recipe, client-side searchable by title+crop via a plain visibility toggle over server-rendered cards (data-search attr; NO innerHTML/XSS surface, works without network). Each card: title, source badge (From us / Link), crop chips, and either an external link (new tab, rel=noopener) or an inline expandable `<details>` body (whitespace-pre-wrap, auto-escaped by Astro). Empty states for both sections (no match yet / box not posted / library empty / no search results).

**BUILD B — `/account/history` (`src/pages/account/history.astro`, new).** Auth'd "Your season so far": boxes-received vs box-weeks-due, weeks-into-season, weeks-on-hold, and a week-by-week list (date RANGE + Picked up / Not picked up / On hold / Box week). Season derivation MIRRORS the dashboard (controlling schedule = configured SEASON_SCHEDULE with earliest firstDelivery; `resolveMemberSchedule` → the member's delivery calendar honoring weekly vs A/B). Holds come from `vacation_holds` so a correct skip reads "On hold", never "Missed"; "missed" phrasing is the neutral "Not picked up" (gray, non-shaming). SPARSE-DATA HANDLING (pickup_attendance has NO writer in-app yet → prod effectively empty): when the household has zero attendance rows for the season, boxes-received is shown as an ESTIMATE (elapsed on-weeks − hold weeks) with a clear "estimated" label + explainer banner, and week rows show without a pickup claim. WEEK-KEY ROBUSTNESS: attendance `week_date` (unknown eventual keying) and the member's delivery Wednesdays are BOTH normalised to the cycle Monday (`mondayOfWeek`) before joining, so the match is correct whether the future writer keys Monday or Wednesday.

**DATA ACCESS / RLS decisions (documented per table):**
- **recipes** were admin-only (migration 0026 `admin_all_recipes`, no member/anon read). Recipes hold ZERO PII, so **migration `supabase/migrations/0072_member_recipe_read.sql` (new)** adds ONE least-privilege ADDITIVE policy — `recipes_active_member_read`: `FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (is_active = true)`. SELECT-only, active-only (drafts/inactive stay admin-only), no PII. Policies are OR-combined so `admin_all_recipes` (full CRUD) is UNCHANGED — weakens nothing. Page reads recipes through the member's RLS-scoped cookie client (`.eq('is_active', true)`); until 0072 is applied it returns zero rows and the page degrades to empty states (no crash). Chose an RLS policy over a service-role read deliberately: the correct least-privilege boundary is in the DB and keeps the page consistent with every other member-scoped read.
- **pickup_attendance** — NO migration. `attendance_self_read` (migration 0011) ALREADY scopes reads to the household (`member_id IN (SELECT id FROM members WHERE customer_id = current_customer_id())`), so the member's RLS client reads only their household's per-member PII rows. A blanket authenticated read would violate least-privilege; the existing self-scoped policy is exactly right.
- **vacation_holds** — NO migration. `vacation_self_all` (migration 0011) already household-scopes reads.

**CROSS-LINKS.** Added "Recipes" (🥗) + "Your season so far" (📦) cards to the account hub (`src/pages/account/index.astro`) matching the existing card pattern (after Refer-a-friend, account-level so both show regardless of share state). The persistent bottom nav is intentionally left at 4–5 tabs (Hick's Law; MemberShell not in scope).

**STOP / FLAGGED.** The dashboard link asked for in the spec was NOT added: `apps/csa-portal/src/pages/dashboard.astro` is LOCKED by PM_ARCHITECT (Phase 2 W1, active-locks.md) — same constraint the Wave 2 build honored. Ready-to-apply snippet for the PM once the lock releases: a small link near the box section, e.g. `<a href="/account/recipes">Recipes for your box →</a>` and `<a href="/account/history">Your season so far →</a>`. The account-hub cross-links already give both pages a discoverable home, so nav is satisfied without the dashboard edit.

Files: `src/pages/account/recipes.astro` (new); `src/pages/account/history.astro` (new); `supabase/migrations/0072_member_recipe_read.sql` (new); `src/pages/account/index.astro` (two cross-link cards). NOT modified: dashboard.astro (locked); database.types.ts (recipes + pickup_attendance + vacation_holds types already present); MemberShell.astro (bottom nav unchanged); no lib helper needed (matching logic already extracted in lib/weekly-email.ts + lib/recipes.ts).

Extended the EXISTING campaign email system (`/admin/campaigns/*` + `api/admin/campaigns/*` + `lib/campaign.ts`) with renewal-campaign tooling and a win-back flow per `CSA_GAP_RESEARCH_2026-07.md` gaps 2/3 + `CSA_MASTER_PROPOSAL_2026-07.md` 2.4/2.5. NO new system, NO autonomous send, NO cron — Todd triggers everything. NOT DEPLOYED; migration 0071 NOT applied — left local for PM. Verification: `npm run build` → Complete (0 errors); `npx astro check` → **11 errors / 0 warnings / 52 hints** (311 files), ZERO in any campaign file — all 11 are the same pre-existing baseline (cycle.ts:682, wholesale/*, market/sign-edit, route/save-optimized), ZERO new vs the 11-error baseline.

**SHARED SEGMENT/DERIVATION HELPER — `src/lib/campaign-segments.ts` (new).** Houses the two season-derived audience resolvers + the extracted weeks-left formula. `weeksRemainingInSeason(schedule) = totalWeeks − currentWeekNumber + 1` is the EXACT dashboard renewal-banner formula, extracted so the two surfaces share one implementation (dashboard.astro is LOCKED by PM Phase-2-W1 → I did NOT modify it; flagged for it to import this helper once the lock releases). `resolveRenewalWindowRaw` (active members whose controlling season — earliest-firstDelivery configured share — is in phase 'active' and ≤N weeks from end) and `resolveLapsedRaw` (win-back pool) both return PRE-exclude lists. LAPSED definition (documented in-code): customer with a lapse signal — a members row status IN (lapsed/expired/inactive/cancelled) OR status='active' but its share's season is season-derived 'complete' — AND no active share now (no active row whose season isn't complete) AND not unsubscribed (no member_preferences.newsletter_opt_in=false; the one-click unsubscribe RPC sets all of a customer's rows false, so "any false"=opted out; missing prefs → opted-in).

**SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (count === send).** Refactored `lib/campaign.ts` to funnel BOTH paths through ONE `resolveRecipientsRaw(supabase, filter)` (campaign.ts:246) that dispatches on `filter.segment` ('renewal_window'/'lapsed'/'active'). SEND: `sendCampaign`:870 → `resolveRecipients`:364 → resolveRecipientsRaw. COUNT: `recipients-count.ts`:71 → `countRecipients`:382 → resolveRecipientsRaw. This ALSO removed the pre-existing duplicated `resolveRecipientsPreExclude`. TEST_EXCLUDES (freetodd21/fakeemailsofake/test@test.com/tinyseedcsa) are applied by BOTH callers (campaign.ts:366 + :385) on the raw list, so test accounts are excluded in EVERY segment including the two new ones. `normalizeRecipientFilter` now parses+defaults `segment`(='active') and `renewal_weeks_threshold`(clamped 1–52, default 4).

Live count, draft save, and save-as-template all carry segment + threshold; `recipients-count.ts`/`draft.ts`/`templates.ts` extended (query params + zod + filterJson). `?template=<name>` deep-link support added so the playbook cards preselect a template.

## [2026-07-04] CSA — Phase 0 security/correctness fixes (deps upgrade + XSS + webhook + CSV injection + route parity) (FULLSTACK_BUILDER)

Executed 5 approved Phase 0 fixes from the July 2026 audits (`docs/audits/CSA_CODE_AUDIT_2026-07.md`, `CSA_FUNCTIONALITY_AUDIT_2026-07.md`). NOT DEPLOYED — left local for PM to deploy. Verification: `npm run build` → Complete (0 errors) under the new Astro 7.0.6; `npx astro check` → **13 errors / 0 warnings / 54 hints — IDENTICAL error set to the pre-existing baseline** (byte-for-byte diff match; the Astro 6→7 major upgrade added ZERO new type errors, and none of the 13 baseline errors touch the 5 edited files); `npm run test:unit` → all 12 files pass (exit 0), cycle 47 ✓.

**FIX 1 — Dependency upgrade (audit H1/H2/H3/M3).** `npm install astro@latest @astrojs/vercel@latest` → astro 6.3.1→**7.0.6**, @astrojs/vercel 10.0.6→**11.0.2**; then `npm audit fix` (NO --force). Resolved: astro reflected-XSS (GHSA-8hv8-536x-4wqp), astro Host-header SSRF (GHSA-2pvr-wf23-7pc7), devalue sparse-array DoS (M3), plus transitive form-data + vite highs. `npm audit`: **20 vulns (8 high) → 8 vulns (4 high, 2 moderate, 2 low, 0 critical)**. Remaining 8 are NOT fixable without `--force` (which does breaking DOWNGRADES): (a) `path-to-regexp@6.1.0` ReDoS (GHSA-9wv6-86v2-598j, H3) is pinned transitively by `@vercel/routing-utils@5.3.3`, the newest version the LATEST `@astrojs/vercel@11.0.2` depends on — npm's only offered "fix" downgrades the adapter to 8.0.4; a second copy (`path-to-regexp@0.1.13`) comes via express under `@lhci/cli` (dev-only). (b) `tmp`/`uuid`/`inquirer`/`external-editor`/`@lhci/cli` are all build/dev-only Lighthouse-CI tooling (L3 was already scoped "build-only"). No production-runtime high/critical remains; the Astro app-server vulns (H1/H2) are gone.

**FIX 2 — Stored XSS in admin route planner (audit H4 + L2).** `src/pages/admin/route-plan/index.astro`. The audit claimed an `escapeHtml()` already existed on the page — it did NOT (the page is one `is:inline` script with no such helper), so I DEFINED one in the inline script (`escapeHtml`, entity-encodes & < > " '). Applied it to every DB-derived interpolation in `render()`: `r.s.name` (:296), `r.s.address` (:297), `r.s.detail` (:298) — these originate from member delivery addresses + Shopify contact names. Also wrapped the API-derived error strings injected into innerHTML: `saveRoute()` `d.detail||d.error||res.status` (:362) and `e?.message||e` (:366), `optimizeRoute()` `d.detail||d.error||res.status` (:383, same L2 sink), and `d.warnings` (:388) via `.map(escapeHtml).join('<br>')` — warnings embed a stop's name, and home-delivery stop names carry the member's Shopify contact_name (same vector; each line escaped, `<br>` joiner kept literal). Also typed `let stops: any[]` → `let stops: RouteStop[]` (imported `type RouteStop` from route-optimizer) per audit Q2, removing the `any` that fed H4.

**FIX 3 — Resend webhook accepts unverified events (audit H5).** `src/pages/api/admin/campaigns/webhook.ts`. When `RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is unset the code previously logged a warning then STILL called `applyResendEvent()` on unverified data (a forged public POST could corrupt campaign delivery/open/click/bounce metrics). Changed the no-secret branch to `return json({ ok: true, skipped: 'no_secret' })` (still 200 so Resend keeps the endpoint registered) WITHOUT applying the event; the verified/signed path is unchanged. Updated the header doc + inline comment to explain why (email_ids are NOT auth — replayable).

**FIX 4 — CSV formula injection (audit M1).** `src/pages/api/admin/reports/[name].csv.ts` `csvEscape()`. Member-entered strings (contact_name, delivery_address, email…) beginning with `= + - @` (or a leading TAB/CR) execute as formulas in Excel/Sheets. Now: if the value is NOT a JS `number` and matches `/^[=+\-@\t\r]/`, prefix a single quote `'` before the existing RFC-4180 quoting. JS `number` values (counts, weeks, days-since) are explicitly skipped so legitimate negative numbers like `-3` are emitted unmodified — only member-supplied strings are ever prefixed. Verified numeric cells (weeks_remaining, total_orders, count, daysSince) flow through as `typeof 'number'` and thus bypass the guard; empty strings return early.

**FIX 5 — Route auto-create week parity (functionality audit item 2).** `src/pages/api/admin/route/index.ts`. The POST auto-create's home-delivery seeding queried `members` raw (`status=active AND pickup_location_id IS NULL AND delivery_address NOT NULL`) with NO week parity — so biweekly members on their OFF week wrongly got a truck stop. Reworked `buildSeedPlan(supabase, weekday, today)` to derive home stops from `resolveCycle(supabase, mondayOfWeek(today)).byStop.get('home_delivery')` — the codebase's SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for who receives a box in a week (biweekly A/B parity + vacation holds + season windows + payment all applied), matching how `/admin/route-plan` gathers home stops via `route-optimizer.gatherDayStops`. Group-by-customer + representative-row selection (prefer the summer_veg box row that carries the address, else any addressed row) mirrors `gatherDayStops` so the driver route and the optimizer agree on the stop set. Host/pickup-location seeding is unchanged (audit verified it fixed). Parity proof: `resolveCycle` builds `byStop` from `included`, and `included` EXCLUDES off-week biweekly members (`cycle.ts:958` routes `!on_this_week` rows to `excludedBiweekly`, never pushing them) while weekly + on-week-biweekly members have `on_this_week=true` and ARE included — so an off-week biweekly member is never in the `home_delivery` bucket and is never seeded; weekly + on-week biweekly members ARE.

## [2026-07-03] CSA — Cooler board (move list + zone board for pack-house/barn coolers) (FULLSTACK_BUILDER)

Built the cooler/pallet-space board so the pack crew knows what's in the coolers and — above all — WHAT TO MOVE and WHERE. The farm is always reorganizing, so it's a MOVE LIST, not a physical map the crew has to babysit. Design followed docs/COOLER_LAYOUT.md (authoritative — "Design approach for the board (v1)", the RESOLVED open items, and Todd's "Key operating rule"). Tracks LOGICAL PALLETS (one per destination) in ZONES (not 22 numbered slots). Mirrors the just-shipped handoff feature's look/feel (AdminShell, ts-* tokens, bilingual EN/ES ?lang=, 44px+ gloved tap targets, styled inline confirms — no native confirm()). NOT DEPLOYED; migration 0067 is NOT applied (PM coordinates DB apply + deploy). Verification: `npm run build` → Complete (0 errors); `npx astro check` → 13 errors / 0 warnings, all PRE-EXISTING (same 13 baseline as the handoff build — box/index.astro, order/[token].astro, wholesale/*, campaigns/*, cycle.ts, etc.); ZERO new in any cooler file (300 files checked, up from 294 = the 6 new source files). All 5 form action targets map 1:1 to the 5 endpoint files; every column/table/enum used matches migration 0067.

Files created:
- `supabase/migrations/0067_cooler_pallets.sql` — ONE admin/staff-only table `cooler_pallets`: id uuid pk; label (destination name, e.g. 'Bloomfield market'); pallet_type CHECK market/wholesale/csa/other; zone CHECK ph_accessible/ph_far/barn/van_overflow default ph_accessible; date_in date default America/New_York today (FIFO clock, never UTC); move_it bool default false + move_it_reason CHECK aging/surplus/customer OR NULL; status CHECK active/out default active; notes; out_at; created_at/updated_at. RLS: FOR ALL USING/WITH CHECK is_admin_caller() (mirrors packhouse_handoff 0066; passes admin AND staff so the crew works on their phones). NO explicit table GRANTs (repo TABLE convention — Supabase default privileges + RLS are the gate; differs from FUNCTION migrations like 0065). Idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS, guarded partial index WHERE status='active', DROP POLICY IF EXISTS); ends with a SELECT verifying the table exists. FUTURE HOOK: move_it + reason kept clean/queryable for a later CSA-box-fill / wholesale-availability feed — NOT wired here.
- `apps/csa-portal/src/pages/admin/cooler/index.astro` — the board. TOP = THE MOVE LIST (computed, glanceable): 🔴 restage-forward (move-it pallets not in an accessible zone = ph_accessible/van_overflow); 📤 FIFO oldest (the oldest active pallet by date_in, surfaced only when stuck in ph_far/barn and not already in the restage line — no dupe); 🔵 CSA-in-Barn-by-Tuesday (weekday ET ∈ Sun/Mon/Tue AND no active csa pallet in barn — Todd's rule); 🟠 Friday reminder (Thu/Fri); 🟢 weekend sequencing note (Thu–Sun, informational — Sewickley-Sat clears space for South-Side-Sun, expected not a conflict). Calm empty state when zero alerts. THEN the board grouped by the 4 zones (2-col grid on lg); van_overflow rendered dashed as a loose list with a "bring back / send out soon" nudge. Per-pallet one-tap actions: move-to-zone buttons, flag/unflag move-it (+ reason select), mark-out (inline confirm), delete (inline confirm), and an Edit disclosure (label/type/zone/date/notes). Prominent ➕ Add pallet disclosure (label, type, zone, date default today ET, optional move-it + reason). Bilingual EN/ES inline STRINGS. All dynamic content via Astro auto-escaped expressions (no user-data innerHTML); the client script only toggles visibility + focus for the inline confirms and the add-form reason reveal.
- `apps/csa-portal/src/pages/api/admin/cooler/save.ts` — requireAdmin + isSameOriginPost + zod. Create (no id) OR update (id present) a pallet; validates pallet_type/zone/move_it_reason enums server-side; date_in falls back to today ET; reason only stored when move_it is on.

- `apps/csa-portal/src/pages/api/admin/cooler/flag.ts` — toggle move-it (body { id, move_it, move_it_reason? }); reason cleared when flag off.

## [2026-07-03] CSA — End-of-day pack-house shift handoff (read digest + 7-block fill + carry-forward) (FULLSTACK_BUILDER)

Built the pack-house handoff feature so "the person working the pack house one day knows what happened yesterday." Pack crew works Mon/Tue/Thu; the FIELD crew takes over Fri for the weekend markets. Someone fills a handoff at the END of their day; the next person reads it at the START of theirs. Design followed docs/research/PACKHOUSE_HANDOFF_RESEARCH_2026.md (authoritative). NOT DEPLOYED; migration 0066 is NOT applied (PM coordinates DB apply + deploy). Verification: `npm run build` → Complete (0 errors); `npx astro check` → 13 errors / 0 warnings, all PRE-EXISTING (box/index.astro, order/[token].astro, wholesale/*, campaigns/*, cycle.ts, etc.) — same 13 baseline, ZERO new in any handoff file (294 files checked).

Files created:
- `supabase/migrations/0066_packhouse_handoff.sql` — TWO admin/staff-only tables. `packhouse_handoff` (one row per shift; UNIQUE(log_date, crew_type) so the save endpoint upserts a crew's single daily handoff; crew_type CHECK pack/field; shift_status CHECK normal/attention/urgent; packed + priorities jsonb; cooler temps + free-text use_first/running_low referencing PH cooler / Barn cooler / truck by name; quality/equipment/safety free text; read_by/read_at receipt). `packhouse_open_items` (carry-forward items; OPEN while resolved_at IS NULL; created_date defaults to America/New_York today — never UTC; created_handoff_id FK ON DELETE SET NULL). RLS: FOR ALL USING/WITH CHECK is_admin_caller() on both (mirrors market_offerings 0054; is_admin_caller passes admin AND staff). NO explicit table GRANTs — matching the repo's TABLE convention (no table migration issues GRANTs; Supabase default privileges + RLS are the gate). This DIFFERS from FUNCTION migrations like 0065 which MUST REVOKE-then-GRANT. Idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS, guarded UNIQUE + policies); ends with a SELECT verifying both tables exist.
- `apps/csa-portal/src/pages/admin/handoff/index.astro` — the START-OF-DAY read digest + section landing. TOP: all OPEN items across ALL prior days, each with age ("open since Wed Jul 1 — 2 days") + a same-origin Resolve button; 3+-day items escalate to ts-danger tokens. Then the most-recent handoff's status band + summary + cooler temps + use-first/running-low + packed targets + top-3 priorities + note to next crew + issues. "I've read this" ack button shown until the current user acks. Bilingual EN/ES via ?lang= (inline STRINGS, mirrors pick-pack). All SSR content auto-escaped; no user-data innerHTML. Mobile-first, 44px+ targets.
- `apps/csa-portal/src/pages/admin/handoff/new.astro` — the 7-block fill form (A identity / B status / C packed / D coolers / E issues / F carry-forward / G note). Progressive disclosure via native `<details name="handoff-block">` exclusive accordion (degrades to independently-openable with zero JS). Block A date defaults to today ET + crew defaults from weekday (Fri→field, else pack), both switch via reload links so the server pre-fills the matching existing handoff (edit path = upsert). Block B 3 big segmented status buttons + 140-char summary counter. Block C per-channel done/target, CSA target pre-filled from resolveCycle (wrapped in try/catch — NEVER blocks the form). Block D PH/Barn/truck temps (truck temp revealed on checkbox) + free text. Block E quality/equipment/safety each revealed only on "Yes". Block F multi-row open items + top-3 priorities. Block G free text. Voice-to-text (Web Speech API) layered on free-text fields as progressive enhancement (mic buttons hidden unless the API exists). Same-origin POST → /api/admin/handoff/save → redirect to the digest. Bilingual.
- `apps/csa-portal/src/pages/api/admin/handoff/save.ts` — requireAdmin + isSameOriginPost + zod. Upserts packhouse_handoff on (log_date, crew_type) AND inserts any NEW carry-forward open items (blank-body rows dropped; existing items are resolved on the read side, never re-edited here → no edit-dupe). Validates crew_type/shift_status/plan_completed (zod enums), sane temp/int/URL parsing (photo_url http(s)-only).

## [2026-07-02] CSA — SECURITY HARDENING of 0065 wholesale admin RPC grant (PM_ARCHITECT)

Caught during PM verification-read of the money-touching migration before DB apply. The builder's 0065 granted `place_wholesale_order_admin` EXECUTE to `authenticated, service_role` and had NO `REVOKE ... FROM PUBLIC`. Postgres grants EXECUTE to PUBLIC by default on every freshly-CREATEd function, so as written ANY anon or logged-in CSA member could invoke the RPC directly through PostgREST and forge/edit wholesale orders — bypassing the route's requireAdmin gate entirely (same privilege-escalation class as the 0053 IDOR fixes). The API route calls the RPC via the service-role client (supabaseAdmin) after requireAdmin, so the correct grant is service_role ONLY. Fix: added `REVOKE EXECUTE ... FROM PUBLIC` then `GRANT EXECUTE ... TO service_role` (dropped authenticated), matching the 0015/0016/0053 hardening pattern. File: supabase/migrations/0065_wholesale_admin_order.sql. Still NOT applied / NOT deployed.

Mirrors 0050 place_wholesale_order EXACTLY (tier discount from wholesale_pricing_tiers, price_cents from active-only wholesale_products, cents math, writes wholesale_orders + wholesale_order_items, dollar total_amount, empty/too_many_lines/qty guards, unwind shell on 0 items) EXCEPT: (a) resolves account by id not token; (b) lines may be catalog `{product_id,qty,price_cents?}` OR custom off-catalog `{product_name,qty,price_cents}` with product_id NULL; (c) PRICE RULE — a supplied price_cents is used VERBATIM (authenticated staff = legitimate admin override, unlike the anon token RPC), else a catalog line is server-priced = product.price_cents × (1 − tier discount); custom lines MUST supply price_cents; (d) status/source from params; (e) EDIT path via optional p_order_id (replaces that order's items, source='manual' only, RAISEs on 0-item edit so the txn rolls back and the order keeps its items). GRANT EXECUTE to authenticated + service_role only (NOT anon). Idempotent; ends with a SELECT proname verify. NOTE: filename is 0065 not 0064 — 0064_product_harvest_crop.sql already exists on disk (untracked, owned by the benched products workstream); reusing 0064 would collide, so I took the next free number.

- `apps/csa-portal/src/pages/api/admin/wholesale/orders/delete.ts` — deletes ONLY source='manual' orders (never chef_portal/import); relies on the wholesale_order_items ON DELETE CASCADE FK (verified in 0044) with a belt-and-suspenders `.eq('source','manual')` on the delete.
- `apps/csa-portal/src/pages/admin/wholesale/orders/new.astro` — AdminShell form (create + `?edit=<order_id>` edit mode). Account <select> (data-discount per account, tier label shown), delivery date defaulting to nextDeliveryWednesday(), dynamic catalog/custom line builder with tier-auto-filled-but-editable prices, live line + order totals (display only; server re-prices), escapeHtml on all dynamic innerHTML, 44px+ tap targets, same-origin POST → redirect to /admin/wholesale/orders?date=<date>. Untouched catalog lines omit price_cents (server prices them); admin-edited + custom + edit-loaded lines send price_cents as an override so an edit never silently re-prices.

## [2026-07-02] CSA — Fix miscomputed count cards + task badges on the admin home (3 of 4 fixed; BUG 4 blocked as out-of-scope) (FULLSTACK_BUILDER)

Edited ONLY apps/csa-portal/src/pages/admin/index.astro (file was PM-locked to this work). Fixes the count/badge bugs flagged by the UX + functionality audits. Verification: `npm run build` → Complete (0 errors); `npx astro check` → 13 errors (all PRE-EXISTING, unrelated files: box/index.astro, order/[token].astro, etc.), ZERO in admin/index.astro — same 13 baseline as before, zero new. NO deploy (PM coordinates).

- BUG 1 (Unfilled-boxes task fired forever): The task queried `box_contents` on the delivery WEDNESDAY (`upcomingWednesday()`), but box_contents is keyed on the cycle MONDAY (`week_date == week_starting` — verified against api/admin/box-contents/save.ts, lib/cycle.ts resolveCycle, lib/week-setup.ts, and admin/share-contents). It matched 0 rows every week. VERIFICATION ALSO REVEALED a second, deeper defect the audits did not name: `box_contents.share_type` in the canonical model holds SIZE buckets (small/large/family), yet the old check compared them against member share_type ENUMS (summer_veg/flower/...), so even with correct keying it would never match. FIX: replaced the enum-diff with a Monday-keyed HEAD-count box-plan-presence check (`week_date == mondayOfWeek(targetWeek)`), mirroring week-setup.ts's shared "box is set" definition; the task now fires only when a veg-box (summer_veg) member exists AND no box_contents rows exist for that Monday (stays quiet out of season). "Fill now" link retargeted from the legacy /admin/box-contents (Wednesday-keyed) to the canonical /admin/share-contents?week=<Monday>. Human label still shows the delivery Wednesday.

- BUG 2 (Route card Wed-only): `isDeliveryDay = todayWeekday === 'Wed'` hid the Tuesday CSA run and the Sat/Sun market runs. FIX: `DELIVERY_WEEKDAYS = new Set(['Tue','Wed','Sat','Sun'])` (the exact distribution days resolveCycle buckets into) and the card copy is now dynamic (`{DAY_LONG[todayWeekday]} is a delivery day` / "Routes run Tuesday, Wednesday, Saturday, and Sunday") instead of hardcoded "Wednesday".

- BUG 3 (Home-deliveries card over-counted ~36 vs ~11): The card counted every active member with `pickup_location_id IS NULL` (a catch-all that also swept in add-on rows and members with no pickup AND no address). FIX: the STAT CARD now derives from resolveCycle(currentDeliveryWeek()).byStop.get('home_delivery') — the households whose BOX is delivered home (delivery_address set, no pickup) — deduped by customer_id, EXACTLY matching how /admin/route-plan (lib/route-optimizer.gatherDayStops) counts home-delivery stops. Falls back to the old null-pickup count on resolver error. The "Members by pickup location" table + its reconciliation footer KEEP the raw null-pickup count (homeDeliveryCount) unchanged, since that section intentionally reconciles ALL active rows to the active total. New sublabel "households on the route".

- BUG 4 (Unassigned Week A/B over-counts) — NOT CHANGED; blocked and reported to PM. Reason: (1) the members schema has NO weekly-vs-biweekly indicator field — the only biweekly signal is `biweekly_week: 'A'|'B'|null` (verified in database.types.ts), so "count only actually-biweekly members" cannot be expressed from the data. (2) The card count is COUPLED to the out-of-scope endpoint /api/admin/biweekly/auto-assign, whose loadState() defines "needs assignment" as `status='active' AND biweekly_week IS NULL` with NO share-type filter; the modal preview is fetched live from it. Changing only the card's count would desync the "assign all N members" heading + button visibility from what the endpoint actually assigns. A correct fix (excluding flex/add_on/wholesale_csa, whose A/B parity resolveCycle already treats as meaningless) must change BOTH index.astro AND that endpoint + lib/biweekly-assign together — outside this single-file scope. Flagged for PM rather than guessing.

## [2026-06-30] CSA — Sunday "South Side Market" source-of-truth fix in resolveCycle (FULLSTACK_BUILDER)

DEPLOYED to production (vercel deploy --prod → readyState READY, target production, aliased https://csa.tinyseedfarm.com; deployment dpl_564VSn4CzhwoKQtDvqCP76Sac72A). PROBLEM: the Sunday "South Side Market" stop (pickup_locations id 8ee7e46b-…, day_of_week='Sun') silently resolved as {stop_name:'(unknown)', day_of_week:null} and fell out of the weekend pack run. TWO root causes, both fixed at the SINGLE source (src/lib/cycle.ts) so EVERY downstream view is corrected at once. (Bug 1 — totalsByStop name/day) The stop's name/day came from `stopMembers[0]`, but byStop keys an ADD-ON row with no pickup of its own onto its customer's BOX stop (the label↔manifest parity rule); such an add-on row has pickup_location_id=null → pickup_location=null, so when it sorted first the WHOLE stop inherited '(unknown)'/null. FIX: derive name/day from `stopMembers.find(m => m.pickup_location_id && m.pickup_location) ?? stopMembers[0]` — the first member that actually carries a pickup. NAME/DAY ONLY; zero count impact (home_delivery + no_pickup_set sentinels keep their explicit handling). (Bug 2 — byDistributionDay) The map seeded only Tue/Wed/Sat and FORCED any other weekday (incl. Sun) into Wed, so Sunday members were hidden in the Wed run. FIX: seed a 'Sun' bucket and stop forcing Sun→Wed (Mon/Thu/Fri — none seeded — still default to Wed so they stay visible). Sun is the WEEKEND run (packed with the Sat markets). distribution_dates already carried Sun; ResolvedCycle.byDistributionDay typing already WeekdayCode. CONSUMER AUDIT (every byDistributionDay + day-grouped consumer across src/, confirmed no Sun gets dropped): (a) harvest/[...slug].astro — iterates ALL byDistributionDay.values() deduped by id and re-derives the harvest day from m.pickup_location?.day_of_week (Sat/Sun→Thu); already Sunday-safe, the new Sun bucket is still enumerated → no double-count, no change needed. (b) floral/[...slug].astro — same pattern (flowers, Sat/Sun→Thu floral); already Sunday-safe, no change. (c) pack-sheet/[...slug].astro — uses cycle.members + memberDistDay(actual day_of_week) and already has a 'sun' day tab + stopOrder filter s.day_of_week===day; with Bug 1 fixed South Side now shows correctly under ?day=sun; no change. (d) stop-manifest/index + [...slug] — render cycle.activeStops directly; DAY_LONG + distDate already include 'Sun'; activeStops DAY_RANK (cycle.ts) already ranks Sun=7 so South Side sorts after Sat; no change. (e) labels/[...slug].astro — FIXED: its local DAY_RANK was {Tue,Wed,Sat} so a Sun stop fell to rank 99 (printed at the very end, away from its weekend siblings); added Sun:4 so it prints right after Sat. DAY_LONG already had Sun. (f) pack-load/[...slug].astro — FIXED: grouped stops Tue/Wed/Sat with everything else in `otherStops` (Sun would have landed there, split from the weekend). Reworked to a Tue/Wed/Weekend grouping (groupKeyForDay: Sat|Sun→'Weekend'), Weekend stops ordered Sat-before-Sun then by name, a Weekend date-range header (e.g. "Sat, Jul 4 + Sun, Jul 5"), distDateForStop now handles Sun. South Side renders alongside Bloomfield + Sewickley under ONE "Weekend" group. VERIFICATION: 47/47 unit tests pass (added 2 new resolveCycle tests: an add-on row first must NOT poison the stop name/day [proves Bug 1], and a Sunday member buckets into Sun not Wed [proves Bug 2]). npm run build Complete (0 errors). astro check: 0 NEW errors in any touched file — the cycle.ts:676 error is the PRE-EXISTING holds-fallback type mismatch (was :674 before my +2 lines), all 13 errors pre-existing. Against LIVE prod data: week 2026-06-29 is UNCHANGED by the fix (before AND after: grand total 83 boxes, byDistributionDay Tue:5/Wed:150/Sat:20, plus an empty Sun:0 — verified by git-stash A/B run); South Side is legitimately absent that week because all 4 of its members are biweekly_week='A' and 2026-06-29 is parity-B (off-week) — the task's 91/5-small-1-large numbers were from an earlier data snapshot. On the matching Week-A cycle 2026-07-06 (where South Side IS receiving) the fix is fully proven: South Side resolves stop_name "South Side Market", day_of_week "Sun", boxes_small 1 boxes_large 0 (+1 bread +1 coffee add-on), bucketed into the Sun distribution day (NOT Wed), and the pack-load Weekend group renders exactly "Bloomfield Market[Sat], Sewickley Market[Sat], South Side Market[Sun]" with other/no-day (none); labels print order ends Bloomfield→Sewickley→South Side. Live routes deployed: /admin/pack-load/2026-07-06, /admin/stop-manifest/2026-07-06?all=1, /admin/pack-load/2026-06-29 → all 303 (admin-gated, deployed; could not render authenticated HTML via curl since admin auth is a real Supabase session cookie, so verified the data + grouping layers directly against prod). ## [2026-06-26] CSA — UNIFIED order cutoff: box swaps + Flex on ONE pickup-day-aware deadline (Mon 7 AM / Thu 7 AM) (PM_Architect)

DEPLOYED+verified live (prod). Todd's operating-model decision: every member has ONE deadline that lands right before the harvest filling their order — Wednesday run (Tue market + Wed CSA + home delivery) → Monday 7 AM ET; weekend markets (Sat/Sun) → Thursday 7 AM ET. PROBLEM FOUND in audit: box swaps and Flex used TWO different cutoff engines that already disagreed — box.ts `isCutoffPassed` was a hardcoded Tuesday 8 AM (NOT pickup-day-aware) while flex-order.ts `cutoffEpochMs` was pickup-aware Tue 6 AM / Thu 6 AM; plus hardcoded member copy ("Order by Tuesday; pick up Wednesday", "Tuesday 6 AM") that also mis-told the 11 Lawrenceville (Tue) members they "pick up Wednesday." FIX (single source of truth): (1) cutoffEpochMs retimed → weekend `etWallClockEpochMs(w,3,7,0)` (Thu 7 AM), else `(w,0,7,0)` (Mon 7 AM). (2) box.ts isCutoffPassed now takes pickupDay and DELEGATES to cutoffEpochMs (no more separate engine; old ET helpers orphaned, flagged for cleanup). (3) Threaded the member's pickup day into all 3 callers — box/index.astro (uses the controlling pickup member, computed after members load), api/box/swap.ts + swap-undo.ts (added pickup_locations join, pass day_of_week). (4) closeLabel → "Monday 7 AM" / "Thursday 7 AM"; flex-order.astro copy made fully pickup-day-aware (Tuesday folks finally read "pick up Tuesday"); box/index.astro 4 member-facing swap-deadline strings now derive from closeLabel(pickupDay). Wholesale UNCHANGED (already Tue 7 AM Wed-delivery / Thu 7 AM Fri-delivery). NET member effect: weekend folks GAIN box-swap time (Tue 8 AM → Thu 7 AM); Wed/Tue folks lock ~1 day earlier (Mon 7 AM) for the Monday harvest. TESTS: rewrote stale box.test.ts + flex-order.test.ts (they asserted the retired 8 AM/Wed-midnight values and were already failing pre-change) to the new unified cutoff incl. exact ET instants, DST, and pickup-day awareness; full `npm run test:unit` suite green (exit 0). VERIFIED LIVE (member-fetch, prod) all 3 pickup types: /box shows Mon 7 AM (Lawrenceville Tue + Mt Lebanon Wed) and Thu 7 AM (Bloomfield Sat); Lawrenceville flex page reads "next box: Tuesday, June 30"; zero stale "Tuesday 8 AM" anywhere. (Preview couldn't be used for member-fetch — Vercel SSO-walled; verified on prod immediately post-deploy with rollback ready.) Takes effect for week 2026-06-29 forward; this week already locked. Files: src/lib/flex-order.ts, src/lib/box.ts, src/pages/box/index.astro, src/pages/api/box/swap.ts, src/pages/api/box/swap-undo.ts, src/pages/account/flex-order.astro, src/lib/box.test.ts, src/lib/flex-order.test.ts.

## [2026-06-26] CSA — Floral list: Sunday markets (South Side) now land on the Thursday tab, not Monday (PM_Architect)

DEPLOYED+verified live (prod). Todd: South Side (a Sunday market) was showing on the Monday floral list (/admin/floral/[week]?day=mon) and should be on the Thursday list (?day=thu). ROOT CAUSE: the floral page built its per-tab flower set from cycle.byDistributionDay (targetDays mon=['Tue','Wed'], thu=['Sat']). resolveCycle's byDistributionDay only keys Tue/Wed/Sat and DEFAULTS any other pickup weekday — including Sunday — to 'Wed'. So Sunday-market flower members collapsed into the Wed bucket → rendered on the Monday tab, and the Thursday tab ('Sat' only) never included them. (The harvest page avoids this by classifying markets via marketTabFor on the offering's day_of_week directly; the floral page is member-based.) FIX (localized to the floral page — did NOT touch the shared resolver used by ~26 surfaces): gather ALL flower members across every byDistributionDay bucket (deduped by id), then assign each to a floral day by its ACTUAL pickup weekday via floralTabFor() — Sat/Sun → 'thu', everything else (Tue/Wed/home/no-pickup) → 'mon'. Updated tab labels + copy ("Thursday floral → Sat + Sun"). Verified live week 2026-06-22: South Side now 0 mentions on ?day=mon, 1 on ?day=thu. Files: src/pages/admin/floral/[...slug].astro.

FOLLOW-UP (Todd: "please do") — applied the SAME localized fix to the other two byDistributionDay consumers so Sunday-market veg/add-on members land correctly:
• HARVEST (/admin/harvest/[week]) — member (summer_veg) side + flex memberHarvestDay map now classify by harvestTabFor(actual pickup weekday): Sat/Sun→Thursday, else Monday (was targetDays=['Tue','Wed']/['Sat'] off byDistributionDay). Tab/labels now "Sat + Sun". The MARKET section already used marketTabFor correctly. Verified live 2026-06-22: South Side veg member (Heidi Weaver) now counts on the Thursday tab (Sat+Sun), gone from Monday.
• PACK-SHEET (/admin/pack-sheet/[week]) — added a Sunday day tab; selectedMembers now filtered by each member's ACTUAL pickup weekday (memberDistDay; home/no-pickup→Wed) instead of byDistributionDay.get(day) which buried Sun members in the Wed bucket. Added Sun dist date (Monday+6) + dayLabels. Verified live: ?day=sun shows South Side + Heidi Weaver; ?day=wed no longer lists her.
Chose per-surface fixes (not a byDistributionDay resolver change): adding a 'Sun' bucket to the shared resolver would make Sun members VANISH from any consumer not perfectly updated, whereas classify-by-pickup-day is fail-safe. The byStop-based pack-check already handled South Side correctly (it's its own stop) — no change needed there. ## [2026-06-24] CSA — Box composition: honor dislikes/allergies as a HOUSEHOLD union (source-of-truth fix) (PM_Architect)

DEPLOYED+verified live (prod). Found via Kelly Corrigan's complaint (got beets despite marking them skip, set before the deadline). ROOT CAUSE: member_preferences are stored PER member row, and a customer has several rows (veg box + each add-on). applyComposition read ONLY the box (summer_veg) row's prefs, so a dislike/allergy filed on a SIBLING row (add-on/flex) was silently ignored — Kelly's "Beets" was on her mushroom add-on row, box row prefs empty → beets never dropped. AUDIT: 17 members affected, several allergy-relevant (Nancy Bergman eggplant/hot peppers, Amy Hepner eggplant/mushrooms, Ashley Lyons eggplant/beets/kale, Karen bell peppers/fennel/rhubarb, Olivia Vareha beets/cilantro, Alan Dum radishes/turnips, Kelly beets, …). FIX (resolveCycle, same pattern as the home-address union): build prefsByCustomer = case-insensitive UNION of dislikes+allergies across all of a customer's member rows, stamped onto every CycleMember's allergies/dislikes — so applyComposition + the label/pack allergy flags honor the full household set regardless of which row the pref was filed on. VERIFIED live week 2026-06-22: Kelly's box now drops Beets (dislike) + adds Farmer's choice; re-audit shows ZERO exclusion misses across all members. 45 cycle tests pass. Files: src/lib/cycle.ts.

## [2026-06-24] CSA — CORE FIX: resolveCycle stamps household home address onto add-on rows (PM_Architect)

DEPLOYED. Follow-up to the route-planner false-skip below — fixing it AT THE CORE per Todd. ROOT CAUSE: delivery_address is stored PER member row, but a household has several rows (the box + each add-on) and the add-on rows are frequently created/migrated with a NULL delivery_address. Any consumer that reads "a member row" for a household can hit a null. Full DB scan of all active no-pickup members found exactly 4 at-risk home-delivery households with ≥1 null-address row: Carla Nappi, Martina Hilldorfer, Stephanie Tomasic, AND a 4th Todd didn't name — Ronelle Myers (biweekly-B, so absent from this A-week cycle but at-risk on her B weeks). The other 11 home-delivery households are clean. FIX (core, single source of truth): resolveCycle (src/lib/cycle.ts §8) now builds customerHomeAddress from each home household's BOX row and STAMPS it onto any home-bound row missing it (add-ons that ride the home box) — guarded so it only touches households whose box ships HOME (never a pickup-box household). Display-only: changes NO count (all 45 cycle unit tests pass). This guarantees no downstream consumer — route planner, labels, manifest, driver — can ever read a null address for a household we deliver to, including for FUTURE Shopify add-ons created with a null address. NOTE: a direct DB backfill of the null rows was attempted but is BLOCKED BY DESIGN — the delivery_admin_only trigger (migration 0030) rejects setting delivery_address except via the admin-approval flow (the home-delivery revenue gate); the service-role key is a JWT so auth.jwt() isn't null. We did NOT bypass the gate — the in-memory resolver canonicalization is the correct core fix and makes the backfill unnecessary. VERIFIED against live DB via resolveCycle: week 2026-06-22 → 8 home households, 0 with no address (Carla/Martina/Stephanie all resolve); week 2026-06-29 → 12 home households, 0 with no address (Ronelle resolves to 600 Redwood Court). Files: src/lib/cycle.ts.

## [2026-06-24] CSA — Route planner: fix "no home address" false-skip for home-delivery households (PM_Architect)

DEPLOYED. BUG: the route planner reported Martina Hilldorfer, Stephanie Tomasic, and Carla Nappi as having "no home address" even though all three have delivered before AND their addresses are in the system (8870 Duncan Ave / 110 Scott Ridge Rd / 2224 Jane St — all on each household's summer_veg BOX row, active). ROOT CAUSE (code, not data): gatherDayStops() in src/lib/route-optimizer.ts deduped the home_delivery bucket by "first row seen per customer_id". But a household has MULTIPLE rows in that bucket — the box row (carries delivery_address) plus any add-ons that ride to the same stop, and add-on rows carry a NULL delivery_address (verified in DB: each of the three has a null-address add-on row ordered before its box row). When the null-address add-on was first, the whole household was skipped as "(home, no address)" and the box row's real address was never read. FIX: group the home_delivery bucket by customer_id and pick a REPRESENTATIVE row that actually has an address — prefer the summer_veg box row, then any addressed row, then fall back; only report "no address" when NO row for that household carries one. ref now points at the box member id. Added a Monthly Report feature to `apps/grant-portal` (Astro SSR). Todd picks a report type (AIG Grant Progress / FVPG Grant / FSA Loan Update) + month (YYYY-MM) and generates ONE self-contained PDF that EMBEDS that month's receipts, saved as a **draft** (build-and-hold) — emailing is a separate, confirmed click (never auto-sends). Installed `pdf-lib` (pure-JS, serverless-safe; no puppeteer/Chrome).

NEW FILES:
- `src/lib/reports.ts` — report-type registry (official recipients hard-coded: AIG→Michael Roth, FVPG→Neil Imes, FSA→Julie Metzler), `parsePeriod` (YYYY-MM → month bounds), `gatherReportData` (month-scoped eligible expenses, spent-to-date vs award, deliverables, FSA loan balance/annual payment + per-equipment fsa_2070_done, and the month's `documents` tied to the grant/loan).
- `src/lib/report-pdf.ts` — `buildReportPdf` via pdf-lib: header page, summary tables, then a "Documents & Receipts" appendix that downloads each receipt from the `documents` bucket (service role) and embeds it — JPG/PNG via embedJpg/embedPng on a fitted page + caption; application/pdf via `PDFDocument.load`+`copyPages`; other types → a placeholder page.
- `src/lib/email.ts` — Resend via direct REST `fetch` so it can send a browser `User-Agent` header (Cloudflare blocks default UAs with error 1010).
- `src/pages/reports.astro` — generate form + reports table (type/period, draft/sent status, sent date, Download signed-URL link, Send button) + a confirm/review modal showing recipient + subject before send.
- `src/pages/api/reports/generate.ts` — builds the PDF, uploads to `documents` bucket at `reports/<type>_<period>_<ts>.pdf`, inserts a `documents` row (kind='progress_report') + a `progress_reports` row (status='draft', report_doc_id, metrics_snapshot). Rolls back storage/rows on any failure.
- `src/pages/api/reports/send.ts` — requires `confirm=yes`, downloads the report PDF, emails it (from "Tiny Seed Farm <csa@tinyseedfarm.com>", reply_to+bcc todd@tinyseedfarmpgh.com, base64 attachment) to the official recipient, then sets status='sent'/sent_date/sent_to. Refuses already-sent reports.

CHANGED: `src/layouts/Layout.astro` (added "Monthly Reports" nav + active key), `src/env.d.ts` (RESEND_API_KEY).

NO schema/seed changes. Reuses existing `getServiceClient`, auth middleware gate, `/api/download/[id]` signed-URL route, `format.ts`, and `app.css`.

VERIFIED: `npm run build` passes. End-to-end against the LIVE DB — uploaded a test JPG + test PDF receipt (AIG, this month) → generated an AIG report → produced a valid **7-page** PDF (header + summary + appendix + JPG image page + PDF caption + 2 copied PDF pages), `embedded: 2`, `embedErrors: []`, re-parsed cleanly. App: `apps/csa-portal` + Supabase. Full security/code audit of the wholesale chef portal before sending chef order links. Verdict: safe to send. ## [2026-06-19] CSA — IDOR fix: ownership guards on 3 SECURITY DEFINER RPCs (PM_Architect)

App: `apps/csa-portal` + Supabase. Live DB migration applied + empirically verified.

**What (security P1, found in the empirical stress-audit dig):** `schedule_vacation_hold`, `cancel_vacation_hold`, and `change_pickup_location` are SECURITY DEFINER and EXECUTE-able by `authenticated`, but took a `p_member_id` with NO internal ownership check (migrations 0015/0016/0030 left it to the route). Any logged-in member could call them directly via PostgREST with **another member's id** and schedule/cancel a vacation hold or change a pickup location on an account they don't own (member→member IDOR). The `anon` grant was already revoked earlier in the audit; this closes the `authenticated` vector.

**Fix:** added an ownership guard near the top of each function, mirroring the idiom `place_flex_order`/`cancel_flex_order` already use — `is_admin_caller()` (admins may act on any member) OR household-aware `current_customer_id()` ownership (`members.id = p_member_id AND customer_id = current_customer_id()`), else `RETURN json_build_object('error','forbidden')`. CREATE OR REPLACE preserves every line of existing logic; only the guard block was added. All 5 app call sites invoke via `locals.supabase` (caller's JWT), so no legitimate path breaks; no service-role caller exists.

**Files changed:**
- NEW `supabase/migrations/0053_rpc_ownership_guards.sql` — the three CREATE OR REPLACE statements (exact live bodies + guard).
- NEW `apps/csa-portal/scripts/verify_rpc_guards.py` — empirical verifier (PostgREST RPC, the IDOR vector, non-destructive probes).
- NEW `apps/csa-portal/scripts/test_flex_concurrency.py` — concurrent-submit double-debit test.

**Verification (empirical, live):** 9/9 checks pass — member→own = guard-passed (hits later validation), member→other = `forbidden` (IDOR blocked), admin→other = guard-passed (admin retained). Member self-service + admin paths both still work. Migration applied to live DB (`[]` success). Separately, the flex double-debit P0 was DISPROVED: 6 simultaneous identical submits = single $3 debit, 1 ledger row (order RPC serializes).

## [2026-06-17] CSA — Vacation rider ↦ parent FK: exact cancel-cascade matching (fullstack-builder)

NOT committed/deployed and the migration was NOT applied to the live DB — the PM applies the migration and deploys. App: `apps/csa-portal`; migration at the repo-root sequence `supabase/migrations/`. Built on top of the prior uncommitted passes (none reverted). Closes the "EDGE CASE LEFT FOR PM" from the 2026-06-16 entry below: the cancel-cascade matched riders by customer + date OVERLAP + reason marker, which mis-fires when a member holds TWO OVERLAPPING box holds (cancelling one would cancel the other's riders too). Riders now carry a real `parent_hold_id` FK and the cancel path matches on it.

Validation: `npx tsx src/lib/vacation-cascade.test.ts` 17/17 (was 16) / 50 assertions; `npx tsx src/lib/vacation.test.ts` 23/23; `npx tsx src/lib/flex-order.test.ts` all pass; `npx astro check` reports exactly ONE error — the pre-existing `src/lib/cycle.ts:673` (untouched; its 0041-fallback select column-set mismatch, unrelated to this change) — and NO new errors in any edited file.

**Migration `supabase/migrations/0052_vacation_rider_parent.sql`** (next number after the highest existing, `0051`):
- `ALTER TABLE vacation_holds ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS parent_hold_id uuid REFERENCES vacation_holds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;` (nullable — only riders set it). Guarded CHECK `vacation_holds_parent_not_self` (a hold can't be its own parent). Index `vacation_holds_parent_idx ON vacation_holds(parent_hold_id)`. All adds `IF NOT EXISTS` / DO-block guarded → idempotent.
- **Backfill (conservative):** links each NULL-parent rider (`reason LIKE '%[auto: rides the held box]%'`, `share_type='add_on'`, scheduled/active) to its box hold ONLY when EXACTLY ONE same-customer box hold (share_type in summer_veg/spring_veg/fall_veg/flower/wholesale_csa, non-rider, scheduled/active) matches the rider's `[start_date, end_date]` exactly. Ambiguous (0 or 2+ candidates) left NULL — never guesses. Links Naomi Anderson's existing 6/15–6/19 rider. Only fills rows still NULL → re-run is a no-op.

**Create side — `src/lib/vacation-cascade.ts` `cascadeVacationHoldToAddOns`:** `CascadeHoldInput` gains `boxHoldId`; every inserted rider now sets `parent_hold_id = input.boxHoldId`. The pre-0041 missing-column fallback regex also matches `parent_hold_id`, and its baseRows (which already omit the column) cover a pre-0052 DB — auto-recovers once 0052 is applied.

**Cancel side — `cascadeVacationCancelToAddOns`:** `CancelCascadeInput` gains `boxHoldId`. PRIMARY path now selects riders by `parent_hold_id = boxHoldId` + status scheduled/active — no customer resolution, no date math, no marker guessing (RLS still scopes the read to the customer's own holds). PRE-0052 FALLBACK: if `parent_hold_id` errors as a missing column (`42703`/schema-cache), it falls back to the legacy customer + date-overlap + marker heuristic for riders created before the migration. Kept the direct-UPDATE, RLS-scoped, never-touch-`vacation_weeks_used` model.

**Callers:** `src/pages/api/account/vacation/schedule.ts` passes `boxHoldId: result.hold_id` (the box hold id returned by `schedule_vacation_hold`); `src/pages/api/account/vacation/cancel.ts` passes `boxHoldId: hold_id` (the cancelled box hold's id).

**`src/lib/database.types.ts`** — `vacation_holds.Row` gains `parent_hold_id: string | null`.

**`src/lib/vacation-cascade.test.ts`** — every cascade call now passes `boxHoldId`; `riderHold` fixtures default `parent_hold_id: 'h_box1'`; create test asserts riders are stamped with the parent FK; the "member-booked" test uses `parent_hold_id: null`; the old "non-overlapping rider" test is reframed as "rider of a DIFFERENT box hold left intact (FK scoped)". Added the key edge-case test — TWO OVERLAPPING box holds where cancelling box A cancels ONLY A's rider and leaves B's overlapping rider intact (the exact bug the FK fixes). 17/17 green.
